Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly switched the identified father from Pieter van Vollenhoven to Prince Bernhard of Lippe-Biesterfeld, despite prior evidence confirming Pieter as the father and even after a search showing Pieter’s birth date (30 April 1939). This misinterpretation of lineage and disregard of already retrieved authoritative data led to an erroneous redirection toward the wrong person.
